'''Torel Fey'jia''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Bothan/Legends|Bothan]] and a member of [[Clan Ojia]], whose [[clan]]-ancestors migrated and colonized the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kothlis/Legends|Kothlis]]. 
==Biography==
Once under the employ of [[MCS]], Torel managed the [[computer/Legends|computers]] in a company warehouse in the [[Warehouse district (Tal'cara)|warehouse district]] of [[Tal'cara]]. In his free time he used to explore, discovered an old loading hatch in the warehouse, used to load cargo from the commercial [[monorail/Legends|unirail]] line; traversing the tunnel, he discovered a [[power generator/Legends|power generator]] chamber 400 [[meter/Legends|meters]] west of the hatch, and caves behind it. Stealing energy from the unirail generator with [[power coupling/Legends|power couplings]], he established a custom computer center there, and moved there permanently. He used his [[slicer/Legends|slicing]] skills to embezzle funds from his employer to support himself, even after the company's collapse.<ref name="guide">''[[Shadows of the Empire Planets Guide]]''</ref> 

He later started his own business buying and selling top-secret corporate information, using his profits to buy the warehouse and expand the cavern, thus establishing one of the largest [[Spynet Facility|Spynet facilities]] on Kothlis. With this information, his good friend, [[Borsk Fey'lya]], was kept informed of anything of interest from the colony.<ref name="guide" />
==Personality and traits==
Torel was young by [[3 ABY/Legends|3.5 ABY]]<ref>The ''[[Shadows of the Empire Planets Guide]]'' capsule identifies Torel as young. According to ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'', the events of ''[[Shadows of the Empire]]'' occurred in [[3 ABY/Legends|3.5 ABY]], therefore Torel was not born long before.</ref> a brilliant but unsociable [[Programmer/Legends|programmer]]. When absorbed, he forgot to politely ripple his fur, and preferred to appear non-descript, blending in the environment or even avoiding contact. As a result, he enjoyed exploring a monorail tunnel and move into an underground cavern.<ref name="guide" />
